handbookNote: Batch 2 depth expansion for Florida notary education-only practice content. Adds 127 new, non-duplicative questions grounded in Florida Statutes Chapter 117 (Notaries Public), Part I (General Provisions) and Part II (Online Notarizations), plus cross-referenced statutes (ss. 15.03, 15.16, 92.51, 92.52, 92.525, 116.35-116.37, 117.10, 319.23, 454.23, 655.94, 668.50, 695.031, 695.25, 741.01, 741.041, 741.07, 741.08, 838.022) and the Executive Office of the Governor's 2019 Governor's Reference Manual for Notaries Public. This batch focuses on material not covered by the batch-1 97-question bank: granular application/documentation requirements, statutory short-form certificate construction detail, the full satisfactory-evidence identification list, additional prohibited-act provisions (117.107(1)/(5), 117.05(10)-(11)), the untapped bulk of Part II online-notarization procedure (definitions, registration, journal/recording requirements, witnessing, federal-law relation), municipal-employee notaries, apostille document-eligibility and fee detail, and scenario/application questions applying already-known rules to new fact patterns. Priced at $0.99, matching batch 1 (2026-08-16 directive: FL has no confirmed graded assessment of any kind -- 3-hour course only -- so this remains education-only practice content, not exam prep).
